name: Knuckle Peal
description: Rap the knuckles on the foe's guard so that a clear peal rings through the arm behind it.

name: Hum Veil
description: Keep a low hum about the shoulders that thins out the force of glancing cuts.

name: Skip Tempo
description: Break the pace of a walk with one missed beat that throws off the foe's timing.

name: Tone Check
description: Ring one note and hear whether the air about the user is clear or hides a body.

name: Tight String
description: Draw the tone of the body taut like a string so that every limb answers the will at once.

name: Glance Ring
description: Turn a blade aside with a ringing tap on its flat so the note tells the foe their line is lost.

name: Bell Strike
description: Strike the guard at its own ringing point so that the full shock runs through the guarding arm into the body.

name: Chime Rebuke
description: Ring a rising note against an incoming blow to throw it wide and answer at once with a rapping counter.

name: Frame Hum
description: Set the whole frame humming in one pitch so that muscle and bone move together.

name: Rib Knock
description: Knock the flat of the fist against the foe's side so the humming blow rattles the ribs.

name: Resonant Brace
description: Brace the frame on a hollow note that lets a heavy blow pass through the body without breaking it.

name: Sway Step
description: Sway out of the line of a blow on a swinging beat and return on the next.

name: Frame Listen
description: Stand still and listen with the whole frame to the faint shaking of the ground.

name: Deep Rattle
description: Strike with the humming frame so that the rattle shakes the foe's balance and breath loose.

name: Shaking Sheet
description: Stand a wall of shaking air before the body so that the force of a blow is scattered across it.

name: Glass Tap
description: Tap a brittle target at the pitch it fails at so that a fine crack runs across it.

name: Stone Listen
description: Lay a hand on stone and hear the hollows and flaws inside it.

name: Crackle Palm
description: Strike with a palm that crackles with fast tiny shocks and leaves the target twitching.

name: Fine Shiver
description: Send a fine shiver along the foe's weapon so that it hums out of their hand.

name: Dampen Screen
description: Hold a screen that soaks up the ring of a hard strike and spares the frame.

name: Shard Step
description: Break the stride into three small quick steps that confuse a swinging blow.

name: Fault Finder
description: Tap an object or a body and hear in the answering ring exactly where it is weak or already cracked.

name: Shatter Ring
description: Ring the brittle target at its failing note until it bursts into pieces.

name: Cracking Pitch
description: Draw the sound to a hairline point and drive it into a seam of armor or stone until the seam parts.

name: Wave Flick
description: Flick the wrist to throw a short wave of sound that slaps the foe's face.

name: Swell Guard
description: Raise a swell of sound before the body that rolls back the force of a blow.

name: Ripple Dodge
description: Ride the ripple of a spreading sound out of the way of a striking arm.

name: Crest Reading
description: Read the crest of a returning wave to tell how far and how large its source is.

name: Trough Hold
description: Settle into the quiet trough between two waves and gather strength for the next stroke.

name: Backwash
description: Pull a returning wave across the foe's strike to turn it back against its own line.

name: Rolling Wave
description: Roll a heavy wave of sound across the ground before the user so that everything in its path is shoved back.

name: Wave Sweep
description: Sweep the arm through a wave and cut the legs of a charging foe out from under them.

name: Chest Rumble
description: Loose a low rumble from the chest that thumps against the foe like a blow from a padded hammer.

name: Whisper Net
description: Spread a net of near-silent listening round the user that notes each breath and heartbeat within a few paces.

name: Hush Shroud
description: Wear a hush about the body that swallows the noise of the user and blunts a light strike.

name: Silent Pace
description: Move one pace in perfect silence so that the foe loses the sound they have been tracking.

name: Pitch Ladder
description: Climb through three rising notes in the chest to bring the body up to its keenest edge.

name: Drum Knuckle
description: Beat a drum roll of three short knocks on the foe's breastbone.

name: Unheard Pulse
description: Push out a pulse too low to hear that shoves a thrown weapon off its line.

name: Deep Boom
description: Loose a single deep boom at close range that hits the body as a heavy unseen weight.

name: Silent Net
description: Cast a wide net of sounds beneath hearing and read from it the position and gait of every body in the room.

name: Muting Press
description: Press a muffling weight of sound on one foe until their voice and their techniques both fall quiet and dull.

name: Mending Hum
description: Hum over a cut or bruise on an ally or the self so that the torn flesh draws together and the pain eases.

name: Soft Knock
description: Knock lightly with a trembling fist to stun a foe without breaking anything.

name: Stilled Screen
description: Set a calm still screen of air before a hurt ally or the self so that jostling blows are softened.

name: Heartbeat Reading
description: Listen to the heartbeat of a hurt person and judge from its rhythm how deep the harm goes.

name: Easing Step
description: Move gently to a hurt ally's side without jarring the air or the ground.

name: Cleansing Chord
description: Sing a clear chord over an ally or the self that shakes poison or taint loose from the blood and out through the skin.

name: Knitting Tone
description: Hold a long steady tone against a deep wound on an ally or the self until the edges knit and the bleeding stops.

name: Piercing Note
description: Loose a thin high note at a single point of the foe's guard.

name: Glass Voice
description: Shout in a voice like breaking glass at close range to jar the foe's senses and balance.

name: Sharp Guard
description: Hold a thin edge of sound before the body that slices the force of weak blows.

name: Flit Step
description: Flit away on a rising whistle and land a pace off the line of attack.

name: Pitch Read
description: Judge the tension of a rope or bow string by the pitch it gives when plucked.

name: Throat Tune
description: Tune the throat to a clean pitch so that every note the user loosens carries its full strength.

name: Breaking Pitch
description: Drive a breaking high note through the foe's guard so that it bores in and shakes their stance loose.

name: Shrill Screen
description: Raise a shrill screen that stops blows and sets the striker's teeth and footing rattling in return.
